text:
Ritu: Drafting release notes for v1.12.1. Small but risky DB change (index + migration). Need pin + announce plan.
Marcus: I'd favor an evening window (22:00 PT) to avoid peak. Canary 21:30, ramp 22:00.
Lina: migration backfill will touch hot table; I'd lower canary to 3% and hold 15m before ramp.
Ritu: ok pin to tag 'rel/v1.12.1-pin-rc1' so ops can rollback precisely.
deploybot: @Ritu Pin applied: rel/v1.12.1-pin-rc1. Canary job scheduled 1764521400 (21:30 PT). Ramp at 1764522000 (22:00 PT).
Marcus: rollback triggers for notes: >10% 5xxs or avg p95 latency +300ms for 10m. If triggered, rollback to 'rel/v1.12.0-hotfix' standby build.
Lina: add DB health checks too: replication lag >30s for 5m. Ops should monitor via the new dashboard.
Ritu: internal announce plan: T-1h to #eng-oncall and #eng, include runbook + rollback command. T+2h wider company note with visible impact summary.
Marcus: I'll post the T-1h ops note. Can someone draft the user-facing blurb for company? Keep it short: "Maintenance: improved indexing, short performance window expected."
Lina: legal/biz: any compliance review?
LegalBot: No data flow changes detected in migration diff. Clearance not required.
Ritu: good. Lina can you add the exact rollback CLI snippet to the ops note?
Lina: will do. snippet:
```
# ops rollback example
deploybot rollback --to rel/v1.12.0-hotfix --reason "auto/alert-trigger"
```
Marcus: also scheduling DB backup at 21:45 PT and snapshot TTL reminder. deploybot: please ensure artifacts retained for 5 days for pinned builds.
deploybot: Backup scheduled 1764521100 (21:45 PT). Artifacts retention set to 5 days for pin rel/v1.12.1-pin-rc1.
Ritu: final checklist: pin set, canary 3%, hold 15m, clear rollback criteria in note, T-1h ops announce, T+2h company. Tagging @Marcus @Lina for final confirm.
Marcus: confirmed. I'll be on-call.
Lina: confirmed. I'll post ops copy in 8m.
Ritu: thanks team. Closing draft - will flip thread to "announce-ready" when ops snippet posted.
